desc: An affordable night vision scope, the X-Sight LTV scope is the latest addition to ATN’s lineup of HD optic night scopes. The X-Sight LTV features the great performance ATN customers have come to expect at an affordable price. The Day & Night mode offers vivid daytime clarity and superior nighttime performance through the QHD+ sensor. The rifle scope is optimized for up to 10 hours of battery life, while one-shot zeroing enables users to find targets with ease. The X-Sight LTV night vision scope is perfect for anyone looking for a high-performance device and hunting optics.
